> Canada.ca AI Components — Plain-text agent protocol
> Free to browse and download. Component markup and metadata are original works; GCWeb class names used under the Canada.ca Design System's terms.
> Home: https://github.com/ednark/canada-ai-components
> Base layer: https://github.com/ednark/ai-component-registry-spec (submodule at _base/)

---

## Overview

Canada.ca Design System registry for AI coding agents building Government of Canada services. 24 self-contained component tiles across 17 component families with categorized adaptation, coordination, and compliance metadata (Standard on Web Accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA). Bilingual mandate: every tile carries languages ["en","fr"] — EN/FR parity is required by the Official Languages Act.

## Machine manifest

> https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/agents.json

---

## Quick start

1. Filter vocab: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/facets.json
2. Discovery index (lean): GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/components.index.json
   (canonical: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/components.index.json)
3. Component source: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/{file}
4. Recipes: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/recipes/index.json
   (contact-form, confirmation-page, search-results, content-page, validation-errors)
5. Version history: GET https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ednark/canada-ai-components/main/infinite/versions.json

---

## Facets

- canadaComponentType — button, text-input, checkbox, alert, table, header, language-toggle, date-modified, etc.
- section — forms, navigation, feedback, data-display
- variant — component variant
- requiresJs — no, optional, required
- interaction — passive, click, focus, keyboard, type, change
- govCompliance — Standard on Web Accessibility, WCAG 2.1 AA
- a11y — wcag21AA, keyboardNav, screenReader, reducedMotion, forcedColors, ariaAttributes
- costTier — cheap, moderate, expensive
- compositionRecipes — recipes this component participates in
- languages — en, fr (bilingual parity mandate)
- piiHandling — accepts_input, displays_only, none
- touchTargetSize — 44px on interactive components
- supportedTokenProfiles — highContrast

---

## Canada.ca rules

- Bilingual parity is law: produce EN and FR strings; the language toggle targets the equivalent page
- No global error summary — inline errors per field: has-error + role='alert' text
- Date modified indicator mandatory on every page
- Dates are text inputs — never add a calendar
- Canada signature and wordmark are protected identity assets

---



## Decision strategy

1. Understand the requested outcome: what must the interface accomplish?
2. Infer the interface type: single component, section, or full page
3. Check declared gaps (registry.config.json) before searching — use each gap's nearestAlternative
4. Search the index, filtering by facets
5. Prefer existing components over generating new UI from scratch
6. Prefer `costTier: "cheap"` and `requiresJs: "no"` unless the task requires otherwise
7. Respect the registry mandates (see Quality gates)
8. Only generate new UI if no suitable component exists

---
## Quality gates and declared gaps

Do not retrieve or deploy a component that:

- Has `costTier: "expensive"` unless the task explicitly requires the richer behavior — avoid for mobile-primary or static contexts
- Has `requiresJs: "required"` when the delivery context has no JavaScript
- Whose `constraints.knownLimitations` block the delivery context
- Implements a concept declared in `gaps` (registry.config.json) — use the gap's nearestAlternative instead; never invent a component-style class for it
- Needs layout or typography classes outside the tiles — use `core-classes.json` (the documented untiled layer), never invented component classes

Registry mandates that act as gates:

- Bilingual EN/FR parity is law (Official Languages Act) — produce both language strings; the language toggle must target an equivalent page
- Inline per-field errors only (role='alert') — there is no page-level error summary
- Every page carries the Date modified indicator (mandatory)
- Check `govCompliance` (Standard on Web Accessibility / WCAG 2.1 AA)

Declared gaps: see `gaps` in registry.config.json. Untiled layout/typography layer: see `infinite/core-classes.json`.

---

## Output contract

1. Reason — why this component over alternatives
2. Selected components — file paths and titles
3. GCWeb classes needed — exact class names
4. Bilingual strings — EN and FR for all generated labels
5. Constraint verification — preserve elements intact
6. Recommended next — what to retrieve next
